high_risk_reason: Directional counting convention varies by school: some count from the bride's star only and score out of 3 in one direction; others count BOTH directions and combine. The from/to ordering is bound to the unconfirmed bride/groom mapping (OQ-2).
description: Tara (Dina / birth-star) koota — health, longevity and fortune compatibility from the 9-fold count between the two janma nakshatras.

counting_rule.description: Count nakshatras inclusively from the FROM partner's janma nakshatra to the TO partner's janma nakshatra, forward through the 27-nakshatra cycle. Divide the inclusive count by 9; remainder maps to a tara (remainder 0 -> tara 9).
counting_rule.formula_note: inclusive_count = ((to_index - from_index) mod 27) + 1 ; remainder = inclusive_count mod 9 ; tara = remainder==0 ? 9 : remainder
counting_rule.directionality_conflict: Which partner is FROM and which is TO, and whether one or both directions are evaluated, is PENDING OQ-2 + domain review.

scoring.combine_rule: Both directions auspicious -> 3; exactly one auspicious -> 1.5; neither -> 0.

notes: The bidirectional-combine convention is used here; single-direction (bride-star-only, out of 3) is an alternative that MUST be confirmed against the frozen source (OQ-2).
Directional counting is flagged HIGH-RISK: the seeker/partner -> bride/groom -> from/to chain is entirely PENDING.
